prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Your Custom Market Intelligence Report
prose.body:
Hello,

Thank you for requesting the Q3 Audience Engagement and Revenue Forecast report from Ivybridge Media. Your customized dataset is ready, including segment-level CTR breakdowns, churn probability metrics, and projected lifetime value models for your specific campaign cohorts.

To unlock the full PDF and CSV exports, please complete the payment of 4481.96 USDC. This secure transaction will be sent directly to our treasury wallet: 0xa71629e81d0f76fbe10bbd0c52c68db649ea4d83.

Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, your download link will be activated automatically. We appreciate your partnership and look forward to helping you optimize your upcoming media buys.

Best regards,

The Ivybridge Media Team
